feeds.title: Transformer World 2005
feeds.description: Transformer World 2005 is the largest fan community related to Transformers toys. It features information on Transformers 5 The Last Knight, the newest Transformers Movie, Transformers Generations, Masterpiece, Optimus Prime and Megatron. Along with daily news, toy resources, galleries, Transformers wallpapers and more are available.

feeds.title: Toybox Soapbox » Transformers
feeds.description: Toybox Soapbox is the ramblings of a man who has struggled to let go of the 1980s, spends too much money on action figures, and drinks enough rum to make even pirates question their life choices. Within these pages, you will find reviews of action figures covering a wide range of toylines from the perspective of someone who refuses to let his childhood go and still can't sleep without the light on if he thinks of the Vigo painting from Ghostbusters 2 before bed time.
